falseSynonyms.zh: 說服不等於吸引 persuade 表示令某人改變想法或採取行動；appeal 可以只是令人感興趣或喜歡。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A design may appeal to customers without persuading them to buy immediately.

falseSynonyms.zh: 使相信不等於討喜 convince 強調讓人相信某個觀點或事實；appeal 強調吸引力或好感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An argument can convince someone, while a style can appeal to someone.

falseSynonyms.zh: 娛樂不等於吸引 entertain 表示使人得到娛樂；某事可以有吸引力但未必是娛樂性的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A documentary may appeal to viewers because it is informative, not because it entertains them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 留下深刻印象不等於持續吸引 impress 表示令人佩服或留下強烈印象；appeal 更偏好感、興趣或吸引力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A product can impress users technically without appealing to them aesthetically.

falseSynonyms.zh: 誘惑不等於一般吸引 tempt 常表示誘使某人做某事，尤其涉及欲望或選擇；比 appeal 更有行動誘因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A discount may tempt someone to buy, while the design itself may appeal to them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 引誘／誘惑不等於一般 appeal seduce 帶更強烈甚至帶性或操控意味，不能作一般『吸引』的中性替代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A brand may appeal to customers; seduce is far stronger and usually inappropriate in neutral contexts.
